description: Bank, cash, PayPal, file-import and clearing accounts (CheckAccount), with IBAN, balance, booking account number and transaction-sync configuration. Read is full-refresh only; the provider documents no filter parameter on this resource. Writes cover creation of file-import accounts only — sevdesk requires bank and PayPal accounts to be created through the UI.

id.description: Check account id; read-only, serialized as a JSON string on the wire.

objectName.description: Model name; always 'CheckAccount'. The read model declares no enum, so none is emitted.

create.description: Creation timestamp (read-only); wire samples carry a UTC offset (e.g. 2024-06-28T14:42:58+02:00).

update.description: Last-update timestamp (read-only); wire samples carry a UTC offset (e.g. 2024-06-28T14:42:58+02:00).

sevClient.description: Owning SevClient relation ({id, objectName='SevClient'}); read-only, auto-filled by sevdesk. Opaque JSON.

type.description: Type of the check account. Accounts with a CSV or MT940 import are regarded as online.

importType.description: Import type, for accounts of type 'online' that are not connected to a data provider. Null for every other account.

currency.description: Currency of the check account; an ISO-4217 code in practice, though the spec declares no format.

defaultAccount.description: '1' when this check account is the default account, '0' otherwise. A flag serialized as a string on read; a genuine integer on the update request.

baseAccount.description: '1' when the account is the base account that comes with every sevdesk setup. Numeric flag serialized as a string.

priority.description: Sorting weight; the highest value sorts first. Numeric value serialized as a string.

status.description: Status of the check account: 0 = Archived, 100 = Active.

balance.description: Account balance as reported by PayPal or finAPI; not set for other account types. A decimal serialized as a string.

bankServer.description: Bank server of the check account; set only when the account is connected to a data provider.

autoMapTransactions.description: '1' when transactions on this account are automatically mapped to invoices and vouchers on import. A flag serialized as a string on read; a genuine integer on the update request.

autoSyncTransactions.description: '1' when the account is automatically updated through PayPal or finAPI; applies only to connected online accounts. A flag serialized as a string. Not spec-flagged nullable despite applying only to connected accounts.

lastSync.description: Timepoint of the last payment import through PayPal or finAPI; wire samples carry a UTC offset. Not spec-flagged nullable despite applying only to connected accounts.

accountingNumber.description: Booking account used for this account, e.g. 1800 in SKR04 and 1200 in SKR03. Documented as unique among all check accounts of the client. A numeric value serialized as a string on read; a genuine integer on the create requests.

bic.description: BIC of the bank this account belongs to.

schema.description: One file-import check account to create. sevdesk exposes no create-at-collection route for CheckAccount; creation is available only through the two disjoint factory routes, and this mode binds the file-import factory. Bank and PayPal accounts must be created through the sevdesk UI.

importType.description: Import type of the file-import account.

accountingNumber.description: Booking account for this account, e.g. 1800 in SKR04. Genuine integer on create, string on read. Must be unique among all check accounts of the client.
